name: dataviz-toolkit
description: Edikted Dataviz platform tools — query data, manage dashboards, refresh sources, deploy reports
long_description: Provides MCP tools for the Edikted Dataviz platform: list/describe tables, run SQL against DuckDB, list/create/save canvas dashboards, trigger extracts, upload dynamic reports, send PDF reports via email. Credentials are collected at install time via Cowork's user_config prompt (stored securely by the host) and passed to the server as environment variables — never written to disk by the plugin and never exposed in chat.

email.title: Dataviz email
email.description: Your Edikted Dataviz login (same one you use at https://dataviz.edikted.tech)
